subject: Control System
questionText:
A system is required to have a peak overshoot of 30%
and a natural frequency of 10 rad/sec. The required
location of the dominant pole is
(a) –3.58 + j 5.53
(b) –2.53 + j 7.52
(c) –3.58 + j 9.33
(d) –3.53 + j 8.55
MCQ 
      MEDIUM
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-07 (Time Response Analysis - (Part-5 & 6)).
